suites.description: Pillow mode-specific image operations across tiny, odd, vector-boundary, VGA, and HD sizes using deterministic varied, checkerboard, boundary, origin-impulse, and seeded-noise pixels as declared for each size; Resize also covers Pillow 13 MKS2013 and MKS2021 filters across its Pillow mode matrix; benchmark subjects are selected independently by target profile and CPU architecture.
